record.scope: Named international crossing and its immediate approach; no whole-country outline is inferred.

record.exceptions: Continuing pandemic passenger restrictions are outside this protest phase. Reports about Bermejo and Villazón are not automatically merged into this crossing’s interval.

record.enforcement: Deliberate protest obstruction reported in the linked contemporary sources.
record.relationship: No matching event in the 726-parent B02 inventory or adjudicated R11–R14 additions; R16 West Africa is geographically disjoint. The same crossing does not make different dated protest campaigns duplicates. Existing AM020 concerns Argentina’s national pandemic entry policy; this parent covers a later civic obstruction of permitted freight access.

record.current_corrections: The reported protest began on Monday 31 May. Access for international freight had been cleared by the report published on 2 June, but the exact lifting day is unstated. Numeric duration is withheld and no ordinary passenger reopening is asserted.
